description: This file defines the PerformanceTrackerLog entity class for a Human Resource Management system. It models the log entries related to performance tracking, including properties such as log message, comment, status, achievement, timestamps, and associations with other entities like Employee and User.

classes.name: PerformanceTrackerLog
classes.description: An entity representing a log entry for performance tracking, with fields such as log message, comments, status, achievement, dates, and associations to other entities like performance tracker, employee, and user.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the log entry.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the log entry.

methods.name: getLog
methods.description: Returns the log message.

methods.name: setLog
methods.description: Sets the log message.

methods.name: getComment
methods.description: Returns the comment associated with the log.

methods.name: setComment
methods.description: Sets the comment for the log.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the status of the log entry.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the status of the log entry.

methods.name: getAchievement
methods.description: Returns the achievement description.

methods.name: setAchievement
methods.description: Sets the achievement description.

methods.name: getAddedDate
methods.description: Returns the date when the log was added.

methods.name: setAddedDate
methods.description: Sets the date when the log was added.

methods.name: getModifiedDate
methods.description: Returns the date when the log was last modified.

methods.name: setModifiedDate
methods.description: Sets the date when the log was last modified.

methods.name: getPerformanceTracker
methods.description: Returns the associated PerformanceTracker entity.

methods.name: setPerformanceTracker
methods.description: Sets the associated PerformanceTracker entity.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the Employee who is associated with this log.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Sets the Employee associated with the log.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Returns the User who created or modified the log.

methods.name: setUser
methods.description: Sets the User associated with the log.
